_doc: The map is a small graph. Each location: name, kind (town|wild|dungeon), desc, tags (scene tags), scene (danger/comfort/threats for lingo), exits { direction: locationId }, place = lingo lexicon id (added at load), lore (a party member may tell it on arrival), encounters (enemy pools by distance), backdrop (svg id).

hollowmere.name: Hollowmere
hollowmere.desc: A village of slate roofs and turnip fields, wrapped around a green with a well. Smoke from the smithy. Geese.
hollowmere.lore: Hollowmere was a Rootwarden waystation once. The well is older than the village; the elves dug it.

thalen_wood_edge.name: edge of Thalen Wood
thalen_wood_edge.desc: The fields end at a wall of oaks. The light goes green. Something small moves in the leaves.
thalen_wood_edge.lore: The elves of Thalen Wood do not forgive. They remember every axe.

thalen_wood_deep.name: deep Thalen Wood
thalen_wood_deep.desc: Trees like pillars. Moss over everything, including, you suspect, older paths. An elven watch-stone, cracked.
thalen_wood_deep.lore: Saint Veyla of the Roots is said to have died here, singing. The wolves still come to the stone at dusk.

goblin_cave.name: the goblin cave
goblin_cave.desc: A crack in a hillside, rimmed with old bones and newer rubbish. It smells of guano and smoke. Drip. Drip.
goblin_cave.lore: Before the goblins it was a dwarven ore-test. Before the dwarves, something else.

old_road.name: the old road
old_road.desc: Cobbles under grass. Milestones with worn numbers. A crow on every third one.
old_road.lore: King Aldric the Unready built this road to run away on. It worked, once.

barrow_downs.name: the Barrow Downs
barrow_downs.desc: Low hills, each one a grave. Fog lies in the dips like it lives there. The grass is wrong: too green.
barrow_downs.lore: The barrows are older than the kingdom. The Cinder Court opened three of them last winter. Nobody has closed them.

hollow_barrow.name: the Hollow Barrow
hollow_barrow.desc: A doorway of black stone under a hill. Steps down. Cold breathes out of it in a slow rhythm.
hollow_barrow.lore: Queen Maren Saltborn was buried here with her fleet's flags. The wight wearing her crown is not her.

mire_path.name: the mire path
mire_path.desc: Planks over black water. Reeds taller than a giant. Every step is a question.
mire_path.lore: The Vessari traded up this water when it was a river. Their wrecks are still under the reeds.

troll_bridge.name: the troll bridge
troll_bridge.desc: A stone bridge over a gorge, with a toll sign in an unsteady hand. Under it, something snores like a landslide.
troll_bridge.lore: The bridge was dwarven; the troll came with the bridge. Dwarves say it was in the contract.

frostspine_pass.name: Frostspine Pass
frostspine_pass.desc: Wind with teeth. Snow in the shadows even now. The pass narrows to a knife between two peaks.
frostspine_pass.lore: Warlord Gruk Nine-Scars held this pass for a winter with forty orcs and a drum. The drum is still somewhere up there.

orc_camp.name: the orc war-camp
orc_camp.desc: Hide tents, a ring of skulls on stakes, a fire that never goes out. Drums. They have seen you.
orc_camp.lore: The Ironjaw Company was born in a camp like this. Mara does not talk about it.

greyharbor_gate.name: Greyharbor gate
greyharbor_gate.desc: A city gate of grey stone, gulls on the battlements, the smell of salt and fish and coin. Guards who have seen everything.
greyharbor_gate.lore: Greyharbor was a Saltwright fort. The guild still owns the harbour chain, and rents the sea to the crown.

dire_wolf.name: a dire wolf and its pack

quests.name: Clear the goblin cave
quests.desc: Goblins from the cave have been stealing turnips, then sheep, then children's shoes. The reeve wants the chieftain dead.

quests.name: The queen's crown
quests.desc: Something wearing Queen Maren's crown walks the Hollow Barrow at night. The priest wants the crown back on the altar and the thing under the hill.
quests.deed: put the barrow wight to rest

quests.name: The bridge toll
quests.desc: No caravan has crossed the troll bridge since spring. The merchant will pay to see it open, by treaty or by axe.

quests.name: Silence the drums
quests.desc: The orcs in Frostspine Pass drum every night. The guard captain says the warlord means to come down when the snow melts.

quests.name: The Saltwright ledger
quests.desc: A Vessari wreck in the mire holds a Saltwright ledger. The clerk says it is worth more than the mire. He may be wrong.

travelEvents._doc: Picked while travelling: 1–3 per leg. kind: combat (uses the location's encounter pools) | wanderer (an NPC to talk to: rumour, trade, blessing) | find (an item/treasure) | minigame (timing bar: lockpick a chest / cross a log / calm a horse) | vista (party describes the view) | rest (short rest, small heal)

minigames.name: A locked strongbox in the grass
minigames.desc: Stop the pick in the green to spring the lock.
minigames.success: The lock gives with a click.
minigames.fail: The pick snaps. The box stays shut.

minigames.name: A log over a gorge
minigames.desc: Stop the marker in the green to keep your balance.
minigames.fail: Someone goes in. Cold, bruised, alive.

minigames.name: A panicked merchant's horse
minigames.desc: Stop the marker in the green to calm it.
minigames.success: It settles. The merchant is grateful.
minigames.fail: It bolts. So does the merchant's gratitude.

minigames.name: A stone with three faces
minigames.desc: One face is lying. Stop the marker in the green to catch it.
minigames.success: The stone hums and turns. A hollow beneath.
minigames.fail: The faces laugh, silently. Nothing happens.

backdrops._doc: Simple SVG scenery keyed by id, drawn behind the 3D stage.
